# Alibaba.com

> > The world's largest B2B online marketplace connecting manufacturers, suppliers, and buyers for global import-export trade and sourcing.

Alibaba.com is a comprehensive B2B platform enabling international trade across multiple continents including Asia, North America, Europe, and the Middle East. The platform facilitates factory-direct sourcing, supplier discovery, and quotation requests for businesses seeking to connect with manufacturers and exporters worldwide.

## Key Topics

- B2B Marketplace
- Manufacturers & Suppliers
- Global Sourcing
- Factory Direct
- Import-Export
- Request for Quotation (RFQ)
- Supplier Directory
- International Trade
- Buyer Protection
- Online Trade Show
- China
- United States
- Mexico
- Europe
- Accio AI

## Core Marketplace

- [Alibaba.com: Manufacturers, Suppliers, Exporters & Importers from the world's largest online B2B marketplace](https://www.alibaba.com/factory/index.html): B2B marketplace connecting manufacturers, suppliers, and buyers globally with factory-direct sourcing and supplier discovery
- [Alibaba.com: Manufacturers, Suppliers, Exporters & Importers from the world's largest online B2B marketplace](https://www.alibaba.com/global/index.html): Global sourcing platform for international trade across US, Mexico, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions
